title: Beyond Trajectory Statistics: Community-Consistent Human Mobility Generation via Evolving User-Location Graphs
title_zh: 【输入内容第一行】的中文翻译：超越轨迹统计：基于演化用户-位置图的社区一致人类移动生成

paragraphs.en: 研究者提出多智能体框架MOTION，通过演化用户-位置图生成社区一致的人类移动数据，实验表现优于现有基线。 Human mobility data are fundamental to Web-based location services and broader urban applications, and mobility generation provides synthetic trajectories when real data are costly or inaccessible. Although recent mobility generators have incorporated collective mobility patterns, they primarily focus on individual trajectories and aggregate population dynamics, leaving evolving community structures formed by user-location interactions insufficiently modeled. In this paper, we study community-consistent human mobility generation. To this end, we formulate mobility generation as the generation of dynamic user-location graphs to model community structures and propose MOTION, a Multi-agent framework for cOmmuniTy-consIstent human mObility geNeration. MOTION consists of user agents, location agents, and a global manager agent. MOTION first detects coherent communities from historical mobility using the Leiden algorithm and extracts community-conditioned interaction priors to guide the generation process. Guided by these priors, the user agents plan mobility, search destination candidates, and infer user movements from the individual view. In parallel, selectively activated location agents infer likely user arrivals from the community view. The manager coordinates both views, diagnoses interactions causing deviations, and attributes targeted reflection signals to revise user decisions, location attraction, and source-user selection. Experiments on two real-world datasets show that MOTION outperforms baselines by at least 4.05% across reported metrics of individual trajectories, population and flow distributions, and community and graph structures. Further analyses confirm its robustness, privacy preservation, and downstream utility. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MOTION-04C4.
paragraphs.zh: 研究者提出多智能体框架MOTION，通过演化用户-位置图生成社区一致的人类移动数据，实验表现优于现有基线。人类移动数据是基于网络的定位服务及更广泛的城市应用的基础，当真实数据成本高昂或难以获取时，移动生成可以提供合成轨迹。 尽管近期的移动生成器已纳入了集体移动模式，但它们主要关注个体轨迹和总体人口动态，对由用户-位置交互形成的演化社区结构建模不足。 本文研究社区一致的人类移动生成。 为此，我们将移动生成形式化为动态用户-位置图的生成，以对社区结构进行建模，并提出MOTION，一个用于社区一致人类移动生成的多智能体框架。 MOTION由用户智能体、位置智能体和一个全局管理器智能体组成。 MOTION首先使用Leiden算法从历史移动数据中检测出内聚的社区，并提取以社区为条件的交互先验来引导生成过程。 在这些先验的引导下，用户智能体规划移动、搜索目的地候选，并从个体视角推断用户移动。 与此同时，被选择性激活的位置智能体从社区视角推断可能的用户到达。 管理器协调两种视角，诊断导致偏差的交互，并将有针对性的反思信号归因于相应的对象，以修正用户决策、位置吸引力和源用户选择。 在两个真实数据集上的实验表明，MOTION在个体轨迹、人口与流动分布、社区与图结构等各项报告指标上均至少优于基线4.05%。 进一步的分析证实了其鲁棒性、隐私保护能力和下游应用价值。 代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/MOTION-04C4 获取。
